name: Ginowan (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Ginowan city emblem in white: a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars with a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ginowan, a city in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Ginowan city emblem — a ring crossed by winged horizontal bars with a stylised character
